correctness.rationale: For every positive attenuation and amplitude and each integer stage quorum, the positive Poisson-tail series proves strictly decreasing elasticity. This yields strict log-concavity in gaps, unique KKT multiplier, permanent zero-gap thresholds, and an all-length maximizer; small-mean Poisson expansions prove the exact asymptotic exponent, fractions, and coefficient. The standalone extracted checker passed 21,494 deterministic assertions, but finite checks do not prove all cases. The exact example follows from 20<exp(3)<21 and strict elasticity.

originality.rationale: Accessible relevant primary works optimize different objects: extinction-sensitive range-shift speed in a network (Hodgson et al. 2012) and maximum-product founder-quorum paths across already placed patches with binomial arrivals (Saura et al. 2014). Prior indexed Poisson budget-allocation and linear dispersal-spectrum claims do not logically imply this exact heterogeneous Poisson-quorum gap-allocation and long-range coefficient. General-purpose convex allocation could conceal a stronger coverage result; priority therefore remains qualified.
residual_risks: General-purpose reliability/convex optimization results may contain this specialization as an unstated corollary; the literature search was bounded, not exhaustive.
The ecological model omits extinction, repeated attempts, alternate paths and stochastic propagule production; the mathematical result does not establish field predictive validity.

The 2026 raster-corridor study was available through substantial indexed excerpts, but direct publisher full-text access failed (403); available methods indicate a different discrete ordinal path objective, not proof of whole-document noncoverage.

value.rationale: Motivated by founder-quorum stepping-stone connectivity and the regular-spacing heuristic for homogeneous chains. The theorem supplies a full active-set classification and exact long-range success law for heterogeneous natural quorum parameters. A concrete three-stage example shows permanent co-location of the highest-quorum link while the least-quorum link bears unbounded distance, a structurally informative counterpoint to uniform-gap intuition.
